asset_set: Questionnaire Q11 option 1 — Producing music tracks

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under keyboard and forearms — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle brushed-fleece hatch on hoodie cuff via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: creative bedroom-studio energy — approachable hobby music-making, not a professional stage
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
readable text, app UI labels, or DAW logos
brand logos on keyboard or laptop

accent.name: KursoKo sunshine yellow
accent.use: waveform peaks on laptop screen, hoodie drawstring tips, key-strip glow

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: headphone ear cushion, friendship bracelet threads

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: yellow appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on laptop lid edge and keyboard key tops
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and keyboard base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: presses a three-note chord on the MIDI keys
left_hand.grip: relaxed spread fingers resting on keytops, wrist low
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: slides a volume fader on the laptop trackpad edge
right_hand.grip: precision two-finger pinch on the slider

pose.gesture_summary: mid-take freeze frame — playing and mixing at once
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

top.accent_trim_placement: drawstring tips and cuff seam stitch

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of forearms works a compact home-studio setup on a light desk. One hand presses a chord on a small MIDI keyboard while the other nudges a fader on an open laptop, its screen alive with a bouncing yellow waveform. Headphones rest looped over the desk edge, cable curling toward the laptop. The moment reads as joyful bedroom-producer flow, not a professional recording stage.

primary_objects.name: MIDI keyboard
primary_objects.material: matte plastic body with textured keys
primary_objects.detail: two octaves of white and black keys, thin yellow backlit strip along the top edge

primary_objects.name: laptop with waveform display
primary_objects.detail: screen shows an abstract bouncing yellow waveform and colored EQ bars, no readable text

primary_objects.name: headphones
primary_objects.detail: coiled teal cable trailing toward the laptop port

primary_objects.name: guitar pick
primary_objects.detail: resting beside the keyboard, single rounded triangle shape

subject.environment: light birch desk surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from keyboard chord hand → keyboard body → laptop slider hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: keyboard silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, DAW UI text, letter A, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, stage lighting, guns, blood
